name: Smale hyperbolic dynamics
summary: Topological methods were applied to structural stability, followed by strange attractors.

name: Kalman filter
summary: State-space recursive estimation unified filtering and control.

name: Algorithmic information theory
summary: Randomness was defined through shortest program length.

name: Surgery theory
summary: Surgery classifies high-dimensional manifolds via algebraic obstruction groups.

name: Sato-Tate conjecture
summary: Potential automorphy of symmetric powers gave equidistribution of Frobenius angles of elliptic curves.

name: Nonstandard analysis: model theory gives infinitesimals a rigorous footing
summary: Robinson used model theory to build a field with true infinitesimals and reprove or extend results in analysis; the 1974 congress president called it a fresh direction.

name: Kervaire invariant one problem solved by equivariant homotopy
summary: Equivariant stable homotopy and a slice spectral sequence show that framed manifolds with Kervaire invariant one exist only in dimensions up to 126.

name: Furstenberg: random matrix products and boundaries of Lie groups
from: Lie groups / harmonic analysis on symmetric spaces
to: random walks on groups and boundary theory
summary: Random products of matrices have Lyapunov exponents controlled by a boundary on which the group acts, joining probability, Lie groups and ergodic theory.

name: Algebraic combinatorics / Young tableaux
summary: Symmetric functions and tableaux are linked to representations (Schensted, Stanley).

name: Rigid analytic spaces
summary: Complex-analytic ideas (coherent sheaves, analytic continuation) are made to work over complete non-archimedean fields, giving p-adic uniformisation of elliptic curves.
